svg.desc: ATALEIR: Spoiler-free hints for story games, as a Windows overlay.; DRISHTI: Cash-flow early warning for rural micro-enterprises.; MAGI: Deepfake detection that admits when it is unsure.; NEETCODE LOG: Every solution I have written down, including the ugly ones.
